user.title: Connect to Dialog Axiata
user.description: Log in with your Dialog ID via SMS OTP to automatically discover and monitor your Mobile, Home Broadband, and Television connections.

otp.title: Enter Dialog SMS OTP
otp.description: A 6-digit verification code has been sent via SMS to {mobile}. Please enter it below to complete authentication.

connections.title: Select Dialog Connections
connections.description: Choose which Dialog services and connections you wish to monitor in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Dialog Session
reauth_confirm.description: Your Dialog session has expired. A new verification OTP was sent to {mobile}. Enter it below to renew your session.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Dialog servers. Please check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_otp: The OTP entered is incorrect or expired. Please check and try again.
error.must_select_connection: You must select at least one connection.
error.no_connections: No active connections found under this Dialog ID.

abort.already_configured: This Dialog connection or account is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: Re-authentication was successful. Your session has been refreshed.
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Dialog servers.

init.title: Dialog Options
init.description: Configure polling frequency and monitored connections.
